current_difficulty_reason: A unit resultant with an unspecified odd degree does not immediately give a coefficientwise sieve restriction independent of that degree. The authors eliminate Sylvester columns and evaluate minors to extract a rational quadratic conic whose solvability forces a prime-square discriminant/nonresidue obstruction. Computing the exclusion density1/(2p) from that new reduction supplies the nonroutine arithmetic step; the precise cited large-sieve and multiplicative estimates then produce the logarithmic saving.
